title: Providing Birth Control Through Home Health Visits
brief_summary: This study will evaluate a program that provides birth control to low income and minority women through home visits by a community health nurse. The goal of the program is to reduce unwanted pregnancies.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Women of child bearing age
* Not pregnant
* Interested in delaying pregnancy using oral contraceptives or a depo-provera shot
* Had sex in the last month or are planning to have sex in the next month
* Have not used contraception during every sexual encounter within 3 months prior to study entry
